text:
emma_cs: Heads up — OpalMetrics renewal ready for signatures but procurement wants staggered sign-off across US and UK entities. Need help lining up PO numbers + showing the credit on US invoice. @rafael_ae @kate_billing
rafael_ae: Quick q — do they want one consolidated SOW with split invoices, or separate SOWs per entity? Customer said consolidated SOW preferred.
kate_billing: I can do split invoices. I need PO numbers for each billing entity, tax IDs, and confirmation whether the credit applies to the US invoice only.
emma_cs: They confirmed consolidated SOW + split invoices. Credit applies to US only. I'll draft invoice memo.
rafael_ae: We'll show the credit as a separate line item: "Early Adopter Credit" and apply to the US invoice. UK invoice will be seats only.
dominic_legal: FYI the UK CFO requested a tiny residency clause tweak in the SOW. Non-material to pricing but legal wants an ack before CFO signs. Can we route the SOW for a quick legal ack?
emma_cs: Plan: 1) send consolidated SOW to Opal legal for ack, 2) apply credit line on US invoice, 3) collect PO1 (US) now, PO2 (UK) when procurement finishes, 4) stagger signatures (ops -> legal ack -> CFO UK).
olivia_onboard: For onboarding: can we provision the extra seats once PO1 is in? Customer wants pilot access ASAP.
kate_billing: Yes — we can provision licenses on receipt of PO1 and agreed payment terms. If PO1 is net30, request email confirmation for early access from buyer to protect billing.
emma_cs: I'll request that confirmation and cc @olivia_onboard. Also ask for their KMS key details for Dedicated plan (onboarding checklist).
docsend-bot: docsend-bot: SOW sent to Opal Legal (link: https://docsend.example/opalmetrics-sow-1780012345) :paperclip:
rafael_ae: Opal legal acked the SOW this morning, CFO UK still needs to sign — expects to sign by EOD tomorrow.
kate_billing: I've created a provisional invoice in our system for the US with the credit line and memo: "OpalMetrics Annual 2026 — Early Adopter Credit applied to US billing". Will update invoice number once PO1 arrives.
emma_cs: Excellent. When CFO signs, I'll finalize invoices and send to procurement. Follow-up: I'll confirm whether they want the credit note attached as a PDF or embedded as a line item. thx :thumbsup:
